automation_evidence.quote: A Closed-Loop Continuous Fine-Tuning Pipeline: A fully automated MLOps loop

metric_evidence.quote: We evaluate CALM on the comprehensive TSB-UAD benchmark. Our results demonstrate that the continuously fine-tuned model improves the ROC AUC score in most datasets

evidence.quote: Our experiment followed a strict temporal split to simulate a real-world scenario. For each

practical_problems.note: static vs fine-tuned model on a chronological 80/20 hold-out; drift is never induced or measured and the LLM judge is not ablated, so this is a score gain, not an isolated drift test

summary: A streaming loop uses an LLM judge to curate anomalies for continuous TimesFm fine-tuning; on 33 TSB-UAD datasets it raises ROC AUC over the static base model in most datasets and lowers it in some, with no ablation of the judge or drift-specific test.
